description: A vendor's offers: public offers in full; network-tier offers only as "Offer available" with a banded amount; redemption URLs for VC-backed companies (redemption.vc_backed) and any other startup (redemption.public). For vendors whose startup offers only go through investor networks (flow network_only): the statement, the work-email check URL and public deals in the same category. Each public offer has about: who_qualifies, customers (new / existing), limits and stacking quoted verbatim from the terms, and the full terms, only where the data says.
